notes: The original face is back: the same eyes, brows, nose and mouth as always, now on a round, skull-shaped head instead of a cube. Every feature lies flat on the face, so no more white slivers sticking out round the eyes from the side. Every outfit was re-checked on lean, athletic and heavy builds, short to tall: shorts, sleeves, pads, bands, shoes, gloves, hats and hair all fit each one.
